notes.title: Shibadungeon Closed Beta
notes.content:
As I'm getting further into development of Shibadungeon, I need some people to help test various different things. So I decided to allow people to request to join the Shibadungeon Closed Beta so everyone can have a chance to be able to help with the game. Just keep in mind that the closed beta isn't just for having fun playing the game as you would normally, it is a way to help in the development process of the Shibadungeon. So if you really want to help test out Shibadungeon, consider putting in a request, I probably won't be able to accept everyone into the program but I will see what I can do. 

The close beta program will allow people access to stable development builds of the game to give feedback on the new features and for people to report bugs. A new build will be able to be tested every week or so containing new features and content, everything in each of the builds may or may not appear in the final product. 

I will be sure to keep everyone updated on new information throughout the game development and and I want to say a huge thank you to everyone who has given me support during the development of Shibadungeon! 

- Tom Brandweiner
